extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders who follow or participate in FCC rulemakings (industry participants, consumer advocates, legal practitioners, policymakers, and members of the public submitting notice-and-comment)
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable Federal Register API listing of Federal Communications Commission Proposed Rule documents; each entry summarizes a proposed rulemaking (title, abstract/excerpt, urls, publication date). Useful for tracking proposals and preparing comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of the Commission's Assessment and Collection of Regulatory Fees for Fiscal Year 2026
rubrics_metrics.description: In this document, the Federal Communications Commission (Commission) seeks comment on revising the fee schedule of FY 2026 regulatory fees and on several additional regulatory fee issues, as described in the text below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks comment on proposed revisions to the FY2026 regulatory fee schedule and on several additional regulatory-fee-related issues (details to be found in full NPRM text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Protecting Against National Security Threats in Domestic Telecommunications Service
rubrics_metrics.description: The NPRM proposes to exclude entities identified on the 'Covered List' (equipment and services determined to pose unacceptable national security risk) from providing domestic interstate telecommunications services pursuant to blanket authority under section 214, and seeks comment on other potential exclusions from blanket authority under section 214 and related measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes exclusion from blanket section 214 authority for entities on the Covered List; invites comment on other exclusions and related options to protect national security interests in domestic telecommunications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combatting Illegal Robocalls Through FCC Numbering Policies; Implementation of TRACED Act-Knowledge of Customers by Entities With Access to Numbering Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The FCC seeks comment on whether to adopt changes to numbering policies related to how assigned numbering resources are utilized, reported, and resold by service providers, focusing on strengthening requirements for resellers that use numbering resources to facilitate illegal robocalls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explores a broad array of solutions to strengthen numbering requirements and policies—particularly as they relate to resellers—and seeks comment on proposed approaches to reduce illegal robocalls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improving Customer Service and Protecting Consumers Through Onshoring
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes rules and explores ways to encourage and facilitate the onshoring of foreign call centers to improve customer service communications and protect consumers' sensitive personal information, including extending protections to email/text/chat and ideas to deter foreign-originated scam calls (including financial deterrents such as bonds).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes applying requirements to providers of telecommunications, CMRS, interconnected VoIP, cable TV, and DBS services and affiliates; seeks comment on extending rules to other types of services and on specific measures (limits on foreign call center use, standards for remaining foreign centers, bond requirements, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reconsideration of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice that a Petition for Reconsideration has been filed in the Commission's proceedings by David S. Keir on behalf of Kinéis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural notice of filed petition for reconsideration—signals availability of briefing/record refresh opportunities; no policy proposals in this item beyond the procedural filing statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wireless Telecommunications Bureau Refreshes Record on Lower C-Band Petitions for Reconsideration
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission seeks to refresh the record on pending petitions for reconsideration of the Commission's 2020 Report and Order in the Expanding Flexible Use of the 3.7 to 4.2 GHz Band rulemaking in light of certain technical proposals in the 2025 Upper C-band NPRM and the responsive record, seeking a harmonized approach across the entire C-band.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests additional submissions to update the record; focuses on harmonizing technical approaches across lower and upper C-band proceedings—invites technical and policy comment relevant to harmonization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spectrum Abundance for Weird Space Stuff
rubrics_metrics.description: This document looks to increase spectrum access for emergent space operations (spacecraft or commercial operations that use radio spectrum for control/communications but are not communications satellites) by clarifying and expanding regulatory classifications, proposing a secondary allocation for Space Operation Service (SOS) in certain bands, and allowing existing licensees to lease spectrum to earth station licensees to provide SOS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes regulatory classification changes, secondary SOS allocation in certain non-Federal bands, and spectrum leasing mechanisms; seeks comment on predictability of access and technical/operational implications for emergent space activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modernizing Suspension and Debarment Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes additional safeguards to protect against waste, fraud, and abuse, including additional mandatory reporting requirements, and proposes to extend the Commission's suspension and debarment framework to additional programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes rule revisions to suspension/debarment processes and reporting obligations—seeks comment on scope, applicability to programs, safeguards, and implementation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lifeline and Link Up Reform and Modernization; Bridging the Digital Divide for Low-Income Consumers; Telecommunications Carriers Eligible for Universal Service Support; Affordable Connectivity Program; Emergency Broadband Benefit Program
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission seeks to ensure that Lifeline services benefit eligible low-income Americans, protect program funding from waste, fraud, and abuse, ensure provider compliance, and update/streamline Lifeline and related rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks comment on reforms to eligibility, program integrity, provider obligations, and updating/streamlining rules across Lifeline, ACP, and related universal service programs to better target benefits and prevent abuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reforming Legacy Rules for an All-IP Future; Accelerating Network Modernization
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission adopted an NPRM seeking to accelerate network modernization by reforming regulations that have impeded transition to all-IP networks—proposes moving remaining ICC charges to bill-and-keep, detariffing, eliminating ex ante pricing regulation and tariffing of end-user charges, phasing out CAF ICC support, and removing obsolete regulatory obligations tied to TDM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invites comment on transitioning to bill-and-keep, detariffing, phasing out supports, elimination of outdated rules, and transitional frameworks to preserve market stability; encourages input on promoting modernization while enhancing efficiency, competition, and service quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet-Based Telecommunications Relay Service Modernization
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes to modernize TRS rules and seeks comment on use of automatic speech recognition (ASR) and advanced text-to-speech for IP Relay, need for IP Relay quality metrics, RTT compatibility, captioning in VRS, VRS calling rules for embassies/consulates, VRS call center requirements, certifying TRS providers, user registration, and updating or eliminating obsolete rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets alignment of internet-based TRS with modern technologies while securing program viability and functional equivalency for persons with disabilities; requests input on technical, operational, quality-metric, certification, and program-integrity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCC Seeks Comment on Proposed Application Limit for New NCE Reserved Band FM Translator Station Applications in Upcoming 2026 Filing Window
rubrics_metrics.description: The FCC seeks comment on establishing eligibility restrictions and a limit on the number of applications each applicant may file in the first-ever filing window for new noncommercial educational (NCE) reserved band FM translator station construction permits, aiming to promote efficiency, curb speculative applications, and preserve spectrum for future secondary services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes application caps and eligibility restrictions for the 2026 NCE reserved-band FM translator filing window; seeks comments on cap levels, eligibility criteria, and effects on spectrum access and speculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlicensed Use of the 6 GHz Band; Expanding Flexible Use in Mid-Band Spectrum Between 3.7 and 24 GHz
rubrics_metrics.description: FCC issued a Third Further Notice of Proposed Rulemaking seeking comment on proposals to improve 6 GHz unlicensed device performance, including allowing AFC systems to consider building entry loss (BEL) for composite indoor/standard-power access points and allowing low-power indoor access points on cruise ships, plus a broad request for changes to reflect technological and business developments since 2020.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks technical and policy comment on AFC/BEL approaches, cruise-ship operations, interference risk assessments, and any other changes to 6 GHz unlicensed rules in light of developments since adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reconsideration of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding; Application for Review of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding; Correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Correction notice concerning a previously published document about requests for replies to oppositions on specifications for Petitions for Reconsideration and Applications for Review; the earlier document contained incorrect dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural correction—clarifies corrected dates for submissions related to petitions/applications; primarily administrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbering Policies for Modern Communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes rules regarding direct access to numbers by providers of interconnected VoIP services, taking action to implement the TRACED Act's directive to reduce access to telephone numbers by potential perpetrators of illegal robocalls, with aims to safeguard numbering resources, consumers, national security, public safety, and rule compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks comment on direct-access proposals for interconnected VoIP providers, protections for numbering resources, and related implementation and compliance measures to reduce robocall risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Television Broadcasting Services Norwell, Massachusetts
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes to modify the Table of TV Allotments by substituting channel 10 for 36 at Norwell, Massachusetts in response to a Petition for Rulemaking, asserting that channel 10 can be substituted while complying with principal community coverage and technical requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes channel substitution based on existing licensed parameters and technical/compliance rationale; invites comment on compliance with community coverage and technical rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reconsideration of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding; Application for Review of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice that Petitions for Reconsideration and an Application for Review have been filed in the Commission's proceeding by multiple parties (e.g., SZ DJI Technology Co., Ltd.; Autel Robotics Co., Ltd.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural notification of filings in rulemaking dockets—signals opportunity for oppositions/replies as prescribed by rule; no distinct policy proposal in this listing entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reconsideration of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice that a Petition for Reconsideration has been filed in the Commission's proceeding on behalf of Garmin International, Inc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural notice of reconsideration petition filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation of the Final Acts of the World Radiocommunication Conference (Sharm el-Sheikh, 2019) (WRC-19), Revision to Table Mountain Radio Quiet Zone Field Strength Limits
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes to modify rules to implement certain spectrum allocation decisions from the ITU WRC-19 Final Acts concerning portions of the radio spectrum between 495 kHz and 50.9 GHz, make allocation changes, and update service rules to harmonize U.S. allocations with WRC-19 to the extent they meet domestic requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks comment on allocation and service-rule revisions to conform with WRC-19 acts where appropriate for domestic needs; invites technical and policy input on harmonization and related changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analog Telecommunications Relay Service Modernization
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission proposes to modernize TRS rules by phasing out mandatory status of traditional TTY-based relay services under state TRS programs; recognizing additional internet-based TRS forms (IP STS, RTT-based relay) as compensable; establishing temporary national certification for analog relay providers; user registration and verification requirements; and updating/eliminating obsolete rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks comment on phasing out legacy TTY requirements, recognizing new compensable TRS forms, certification and verification processes, and measures to preserve TRS availability while preventing waste, fraud, and abuse during network transitions.
